notes.title: Patch Note 1.3
notes.content:
We’re there! This update fixes the last known bugs in UnSeen, including:

A bug with the entity's spawn, which always appeared in the west wing instead of near the player.

A bug affecting the "inoffensive" and "absent" modes of the entity, which weren’t activating properly.

A bug involving the appearance of a safe in the Heartwoods' bedroom.

It also adds save points throughout the manor. Their absence was quite a shameful oversight, and I’m glad to have fixed it!

Please don’t hesitate to report any bugs you find or share any clips you make — both are incredibly helpful to me!

notes.title: Update note for 03/01
notes.content:
A First Update on UnSeen, to celebrate the New Year!

On the program:
- a little bit of content addition
> 6 new notes scattered all over the mansion

- several quality of life changes
> added a warning when deactivating the entity.
> default opening of a fence that tended to trap players ;-)

- a lot of bug fixes among the issues reported by my community:
> fixed some translation errors (display of words in English on the French version, some mistakes in English too)
> fixed a (big) performance problem due to a sub-optimization of the lights.
> fixed a bug that prevented the entity from appearing under certain conditions.
> fixed a bug allowing the entity to appear, even in harmless mode.

> fixed a door whose latch refused to work
> fixed the direction of a door, which when opening crossed others
> fixed a fence that reappeared and trapped the player during exploration.

Thank you for all your feedback, and enjoy your adventures!
